## Sheet F5 — Tulip Nắng + Cẩm Tú Cầu Mưa

- Lưu thành: `art_inbox/.batch/cloud-05-flowers/F5.png`
- Đính kèm (theo thứ tự): `1_style_flora.png`
- Kết quả: lưới 2×4: flower_sun_tulip_sprout, flower_sun_tulip_grow, flower_sun_tulip_ripe, flower_sun_tulip_wilt, flower_rain_hydrangea_sprout, flower_rain_hydrangea_grow, flower_rain_hydrangea_ripe, flower_rain_hydrangea_wilt

```text
Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE: finished art from my game. Copy its art style exactly: a dark warm-brown outline (never black) of even weight, soft cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from the top-left, warm pastel colours of medium saturation, a subtle painted texture, rounded chunky friendly shapes, low-to-medium detail. Do NOT copy the objects of image 1.

Draw ONE image: a sheet of 8 separate game sprites in a clean grid of 2 row(s) x 4 column(s), in exactly this order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) Sun Tulip sprout: two smooth pointed green leaves; (2) Sun Tulip growing: a closed golden bud on a straight stem; (3) Sun Tulip in full bloom: three cup-shaped tulips in warm sunshine yellow fading to orange at the tips, petal tips shaped like soft sun rays; (4) Sun Tulip wilted.
Row 2: (1) Rain Hydrangea sprout with two broad serrated leaves; (2) Rain Hydrangea growing: a leafy bush with a tight green bud cluster; (3) Rain Hydrangea in full bloom: two round pom-pom flower clusters in rain-blue and periwinkle, each tiny petal with a little raindrop-shaped pale highlight; (4) Rain Hydrangea wilted.
Each plant is seen from the side and slightly above, standing upright; its stem ends at the bottom in a very small mound of soil. No pot, no grass patch, no ground, no cloud platform.
Each row is ONE plant in 4 growth stages drawn at the SAME scale: 1 sprout (tiny, two leaves), 2 growing (young leafy plant with a closed bud, about half height), 3 ripe (full bloom, tallest), 4 wilted (the ripe plant drooping, faded brownish petals, curled leaves, about the height of stage 2). Keep the same colours and leaf shape across the row.

Every object is fully visible and centred in its own cell, with wide empty gaps between objects; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into another cell. Wide landscape image.
Background: one plain flat light-grey colour (#C8C8C8) everywhere. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border or frame. Not glossy, not a 3D render, not flat vector, not pixel art. No glow, no sparkles, no floating particles.
```
